description: This is a CMake module script to locate and configure the bcm_host library, mainly used on Raspberry Pi platforms. It checks for the library's presence, handles dependencies, and sets up imported targets for use in other CMake files.

methods.name: find_package
methods.description: Searches for the specified package, in this case, PkgConfig.

methods.name: pkg_check_modules
methods.description: Checks for the existence of specified pkg-config modules.

methods.name: find_library
methods.description: Locates a library in the system.

methods.name: find_package_handle_standard_args
methods.description: Handles the standard process of validating package detection.

methods.name: add_library
methods.description: Creates an imported or static library target.

methods.name: set_target_properties
methods.description: Sets properties on a target, such as location and compiling options.
